tools.name: generate_cross_sums
tools.description: Use this when the user wants printable cross-sum puzzles (cross sums, number crossword puzzles with sums, addition logic puzzles) as a PDF with an answer key, or wants to solve one on screen. Each grid from 6 x 6 to 12 x 12 (counting the clue row and column) has white squares for the digits 1 to 9 a
